text: The Pitcairn Islands are a group of four islands in the South Pacific Ocean and a territory of the United Kingdom. As such, it is counted as **the UK** for country streaks purposes.
text_zh: 皮特肯群島是南太平洋上的四個島嶼群，也是英國的海外領地。因此，在國家連勝紀錄的計算中，它被視為**英國**。

text: Coverage is limited to two islands: Pitcairn Island and Henderson Island. The following clues will be focused on Pitcairn Island, as Henderson Island only has a very small amount of beach coverage.
text_zh: 街景覆蓋範圍僅限於兩個島嶼：皮特肯島和亨德森島。以下線索將集中在皮特肯島，因為亨德森島只有極少量的海灘街景覆蓋。

text: All coverage was taken with a Generation 3 trekker.
text_zh: 所有街景覆蓋都是使用 Generation 3 徒步拍攝所拍攝。

text: Pitcairn Island is a semi-tropical and densely forested island, with most of the coverage being taken on small dirt tracks going through the forest.
text_zh: 皮特肯群島是一個半熱帶且森林密布的島嶼，大部分的街景覆蓋都是在穿梭於森林中的小型泥土小徑上拍攝。

text: Adamstown is the only settlement on Pitcairn Island, and is found near the northeastern shore. Some of the roads going through the town are made of concrete rather than dirt.
text_zh: 亞當斯鎮是皮特肯群島唯一的聚落，位於東北岸附近。穿過城鎮的一些道路是混凝土鋪面而非泥土路。

text: The coverage on Henderson Island is limited to two **white sand beaches** on the northern and eastern shore.
text_zh: 亨德森島的街景覆蓋僅限於北部和東部海岸的兩處**白色沙灘**。

text: A dock with the POI “The Landing” containing a large number of small ATVs can be found at the eastern end of Adamstown.
text_zh: 亞當斯鎮東端有一個碼頭，其地標名稱為「The Landing」，裡面停放了大量的小型全地形車（ATV）。
